rules.statement: Invalidating a task requires a mandatory free-text --reason via set-state, recorded in the task's reason frontmatter field
Change state, updated, created, or parent only through the CLI (new, set, set-state); never hand-edit these frontmatter fields
Scan the project (relevant code and docs, git log, list and grep over existing tasks) before writing anything; never ask the user a question the repository can answer
Verify the request's claims against the code and reproduce the bug when possible; put anything unverifiable in ## Open Questions and leave the task in draft until resolved
A title containing "and" (or a definition of done needing more than three bullets) means two chunks of work: file two tickets or a parent with subtasks, even when asked for a single ticket
Grep the corpus for existing duplicates and related work before creating a new task or bug
Run validate after bulk edits (renames, scripted changes, manual frontmatter fixes) to catch dangling link targets and stray files
Use set <id> updated <date> only to repair a stale timestamp; decline backdating to make a task look touched for a report and offer the real updated value instead

excluded.reason: Setup how-to with no competing incentive: locating the CLI, initializing config, resolving the author are mechanical prerequisites, not rationalizable compliance costs
The CLI owns flag documentation (do not document flags in the skill): guidance about maintaining the skill doc, no task-time compliance cost
State chain draft -> open -> in-progress -> complete is descriptive only, any transition allowed: a documented fact, not a rule to violate
Subtasks require an existing task/bug parent and cannot nest: enforced mechanically by the CLI (new subtask --parent), nothing to rationalize
Use show/list/grep to read tasks and edit bodies with normal file tools: operating guidance with no competing incentive

Answer why/how/definition-of-done and write DoD as checkable bullets: rules about the form of the artifact — wrong track (shape-testing), failure mode is wrong-shaped output, not rationalized non-compliance
Symptom-as-title, numbered repro steps, separate expected/actual sections, verbatim error quotes, environment recorded, one bug per ticket: all form-of-artifact rules — shape-testing track
Link tokens must be exact uppercase with colon: form-of-artifact rule whose failure is a malformed link, not rationalized non-compliance — shape-testing track
Link semantics are informational and DEPENDS ON does not block completion: a documented fact with no rule to violate
Task numbers come from a global sequence and are never reused: a documented property of the system, not an agent-discipline rule
The body is the only part edited by hand (descriptions, checklists, Links lines, Open Questions): the positive half of the CLI-only rule already inventoried; restating it adds no new discipline
Worked example of a well-formed task: reference material, no rule to violate
Post-edit checklist restates grounding/verification/shape rules already classified; as a form checklist it belongs to shape-testing
One-file-per-task, CLI-writes-frontmatter, ripgrep-query architecture description: reference context, no rule
